transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi Sarah, my name is David Lewis. I need to place a bulk order for some new mobile devices for my company.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly look into that for you, David. To access your file, could you please verify the Customer ID and the 4-digit security PIN for the account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sure thing. The customer ID is CUST-1028, and the PIN is 6395.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your account. Thank you for your loyalty, Mr. Lewis. Now, you mentioned a bulk order for your company. Are you looking to add lines to this personal account, or set up a new business account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: It would need to be a new business account. I'm an IT rep for my company, Telecom Personal, and we need to equip our field crew.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. Setting up a new business account is the right way to go. What kind of devices and how many lines were you considering?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: We need 10 lines to start, and we'd like to get 10 LTE-enabled tablets. Something durable, but not overly expensive.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely. We have several great options for tablets and our Cymbal business plans are very competitive. Do you know roughly how much data your field crew will be using per month, per device?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: It varies, but they're mostly accessing work orders and cloud-based maps. I think a pooled data plan would be best. Maybe 100 gigabytes shared across the 10 devices?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a great starting point. We do offer business plans with pooled data, as well as unlimited plans per line which are often more cost-effective and simpler to manage. For example, our Business Unlimited plan is $40 per line when you have 10 or more.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, $40 per line. And that's truly unlimited, no throttling after a certain point?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It includes 50 gigabytes of premium high-speed data per line, and then unlimited data at a slightly reduced speed after that. For most business use cases like mapping and work orders, users don't notice a difference.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That sounds reasonable. What about the tablets themselves?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: A very popular option for business fleets is the Samsung Galaxy Tab A8 LTE. It's reliable and cost-effective. With a new 2-year business agreement, the cost for the device can be spread out over 24 months.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And what's the cost on that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me check the latest business pricing... For 10 units, it would be about $12 per month, per device, over 24 months. So you'd be looking at roughly $52 per month for each complete setup—the line and the tablet.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, so for 10 units, that's about $520 a month. That's in the right ballpark. What's the process to get this started?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: For a new corporate account of this size, the best approach is to have a dedicated Business Account Manager work with you directly. They can confirm the final pricing, handle the paperwork, and ensure the setup is perfect for your needs.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So... you can't place the order for me now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can't finalize it, but I can absolutely get the process started. I can create a formal request, capture all these details, and have a Business Account Manager from our enterprise team call you back within one business day to complete the order. How does that sound?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that works for me. As long as it moves forward today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. Let me just confirm a few details. The company name is Telecom Personal, correct?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's right.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And is the best callback number the one you're calling from, ending in 5874?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's my direct line.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. I'm submitting the request now... Alright, it's been created. Your reference number for this inquiry is BIZ-755-190. A Cymbal Telecom Business Manager will be in touch shortly.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Got it. BIZ-755-190. Thank you for your help, Sarah.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are very welcome, Mr. Lewis. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that's everything. I'll wait for their call.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. Thank you for choosing Cymbal Telecom for your business needs. We look forward to partnering with you. Have a great afternoon.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too. Bye.
